items.prompt: Why sort after selecting heap membership?

options.why: Counts remain in each heap tuple; sorting is needed for their display order, not to recover missing data.
Python can sort these numeric tuples directly; strings are not required.

options.text: Heap layout is not report order
options.why: The heap guarantees a minimum root, not a fully sorted array; the retained members must be sorted for the requested report.
Negative values are valid keys here and are handled by the same count/tie ranking.

items.explanation: Heap invariant only orders root against descendants.
